db.posts.aggregate([ { $match: { "engagement_scores": { $gt: 70 } } }, { $group: { _id: "$category", matched_count: { $sum: 1 }, avg_value: { $avg: "$engagement_scores" } } }, { $sort: { matched_count: -1, avg_value: -1 } }, { $project: { _id: 0, category: "$_id", matched_count: 1, avg_value: 1 } }])
